banner.title: FAMILIES, CLASS, AND CASTE, printed capture pp. 60-62 - the OA Chapter 3 opener round
banner.provenance: verified against capture pp. 60-62 of the oa.pdf OCR session (single Mistral-OCR capture; cites are capture pages). ONE CONTESTED CELL SETTLED AGAINST THE 2018 PRINT BEFORE PINNING: the T38 row-27 ancestry cell d100/8 (the first capture printed d100/9, the second d100/8 - the settled reading stands). The T38 holds seventeen printed rows (the 2d10 bands 2 through 30 - the first preflight run mispinned eighteen and the battery caught bad 14); the T38 rank column pins as the 0-16 code (outcast 0 through the 1st Rank 16); the ancestry and birthright dice pin as die codes (d4=4 through d100=100) with the rolls as the after-slash counts; the T37 requirement columns pin as the 0/1 code. OCR normalization: "should affect and NPC" reads as should affect an NPC; "1 d6" reads as 1d6; the Table 38 header spans two rows in the second capture (the printed six-column header stands)
banner.sentinel: the gap census after this round: 67 closed, 168 open - the Birth Rank prose, Table 37 and Table 38 boxes flip (census 551 -> 552); NEXT - R630: the Family Structure and Additional Family Structures prose, capture pp. 62-64, the family chart rows with the honor-by-position doctrine, prefix dgq (verify free), audit "R630 OA family structures audit", include after rules/oabirth.h
